goal_checks.notes: The hook plans only when the paste is non-empty, and its view counts equal planReimport's updates/unanchored/orphans/missing lengths. use-reimport-review.test.ts pins the matched case and the orphan+missing case.

apply iterates only plan.updates, resolves each slug to a highlight, updates the caller's existing note (skipping an identical body) or inserts one; orphans and anchorless sections are never written. Four hook tests prove update-once, insert, idempotent re-apply, and orphan no-op.

NotePanel renders ReimportReview at the bottom of the rail; the control toggles a paste panel with the counts and an Apply button (disabled unless something matched). reimport-review.test.tsx pins it.
Hook and component tests exist and pass (5 + 3), and the note-panel suite still passes with the control mounted.
